heading: INT. ABANDONED PLANETARIUM - DOME ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ABANDONED PLANETARIUM - DOME ROOM - NIGHT
Dust on every seat.
A cracked star projector hangs in the center like a dead insect.
Flashlight beams cross the ceiling.
INSPECTOR LOUELLA PRICE (50s, rain-wet mac) kneels beside the projector.
DR. MIRIAM ASHBY (40s, pathologist) stands behind her with a case.
CONSTABLE FIONA GREAVES (20s, notebook out) waits at the door.
Louella lifts a brass key from the projector's base.
Miriam and Fiona both step forward at once, collide, and stop.
Careful. Nobody touch it.
units.name: LOUELLA

units.text: The note says nine o'clock. It is quarter past.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Then she is late, or she is not coming.
units.name: FIONA

units.text: She is here. She is watching us.
units.name: LOUELLA

units.text: Why would she do that?
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Because she wanted us to find the key, and now she wants to see what we do with it.
units.name: LOUELLA

units.text: Fiona and Miriam both glance up.
The dome is empty, except for the flashlights.
Louella pockets the key.
Shall I call it in?
units.name: FIONA

units.text: Not yet. Let her think she has the night to herself.
units.name: LOUELLA
